identity.title: Retain Morphology Tool Partial after concrete owner audit

origin.summary: The user requested that Partial refactoring continue in scheduled cycles and that each remaining Partial be structurally reviewed rather than mechanically deleted or split.

state.current_summary: MorphologyToolWpfView.xaml.cs를 no-change 구조 감사로 재확인했다. View Partial은 XAML/composition adapter로 유지되고, presenter/ViewModel/interaction/kernel/base가 property, mutable/settings, interaction, input, preview/lifetime 경계를 각각 소유한다. 새 독립 state/lifetime/test seam이 없어 production split은 만들지 않았으며, Debug/Release contract/build와 Morphology WPF smoke가 통과했다.

objective.summary: Audit MorphologyToolWpfView's Partial structure and retain it only if existing concrete owners already provide the necessary state, interaction, persistence, and lifetime boundaries without a new split.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not add a service, interface, manager, wrapper, forwarding Partial, or ViewModel split for file length alone.
Preserve MorphologyToolWpfView XAML names, property binding facade, Learn action, preview path, and DisposeView lifetime.
Keep test outputs and evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or mutate the Original repository.

criteria.text: The proof report records current/intended owners, caller path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, binding/public contract, shortest reading order, and the reason no production split is justified.

The source contract proves that the View Partial has no direct persistence/file-dialog/algorithm-construction coupling and that existing presenter, ViewModel, interaction, kernel, factory, and base lifetime owners are wired.
Focused Debug/Release contracts and builds plus relevant WPF smoke pass; broader theme/DPI/input/camera/SDK/GPU/native runtime remains explicitly unverified.

evidence.observation: MorphologyToolWpfView remains a cohesive XAML/composition adapter. The presenter, ViewModel, interaction controller, kernel controller, factory, and base View provide concrete property, mutable/settings, interaction, input, creation, and lifetime owners; no direct persistence/dialog/algorithm-construction coupling exists in the View Partial.
MorphologyToolPartialBoundaryContract passed 6/6 in Debug and Release, proving retained owner wiring and no-change coupling checks.

VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug/Release builds passed with 0 warnings/errors; PipelineViewerScreenshotSmoke x64 Debug had 0 errors and two pre-existing MSB3270 warnings; one-monitor Morphology layout and standalone UI smoke passed with fresh PNGs. Broader UI/native matrices remain unverified.

events.summary: MorphologyToolWpfView Partial은 required XAML/composition adapter이고, 기존 presenter/ViewModel/interaction/kernel/base가 독립 책임과 lifetime을 이미 제공한다. 새 seam 없이 분리하면 wrapper나 중복 상태가 되므로 no-change로 유지한다.
PL-0036의 세 completion criteria가 현재 증거로 충족되어 resolved로 닫는다. 전체 theme/DPI/input, camera/SDK/GPU 및 long-running native runtime은 이 slice의 검증 범위가 아니다.

The Morphology Partial retained-owner audit found no independent boundary that justified a production split; focused source/build/WPF evidence was recorded. Do not reopen without a new requirement, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency/lifetime boundary.
